content.title: High Point vs. Arkansas: Prediction, How to Watch for Free (3/21)
content.text: No. 12 High Point (31–4) faces No. 4 Arkansas (27–8) tonight in the 2026 NCAA Tournament second round at Moda Center in Portland, as the Panthers look to keep their Cinderella story alive. High Point pulled off an 83–82 upset over No. 5 Wisconsin on a game-winning layup by Chase Johnston with less than 12 seconds left, racing across the court in transition for his first two-point basket of the season. The mid-major Panthers put the country on notice with their fearless style of play and electric, high-volume shooting from deep. Senior Rob Martin led with a 23-point, 10-assist double-double, while three others, including Johnston, scored 14 or more in a balanced effort. Wisconsin’s backcourt of John Blackwell and Nick Boyd combined for 49 points — over half of the team’s total. Transition points were key for High Point, which finished with 16 fast-break points, compared to just five for Wisconsin. The Panthers now face one of the nation’s most prolific scoring teams, the Arkansas Razorbacks, who come in off a commanding 97–78 win over Hawai‘i on Thursday. Darius Acuff Jr. led the Razorbacks with 24 points and seven assists, while Meleek Thomas added 21 points and Trevon Brazile contributed 19. Four Arkansas starters scored 16 or more as the Razorbacks shot over 54% from the field and controlled the game early with dominant interior play and high-tempo offense, finishing with 64 points in the paint and 23 fast-break points. This should be an exciting, high-tempo game, especially given the Razorbacks’ defensive weakness. Expect a tight first half with Acuff stepping it up late and powering Arkansas to victory. Predicted Final Score: Arkansas 89, High Point 81 How to Watch High Point vs. Arkansas Tip-off for today’s game between High Point and Arkansas is set for 9:45 PM Eastern / 8:45 PM Central / 6:45 PM Pacific at the Moda Center in Portland, Oregon. The game airs on TBS and streams live on the TBS app and website, as well as HBO Max. If you’re a cord-cutter without an active livestreaming plan, you can watch the game for free by taking advantage of free trials from DIRECTV STREAM, Hulu + Live TV, or YouTube TV. Hulu + Live TV also includes Disney+ and ESPN Select as part of its standard plan.
